title: Circuit transition as a machine action
statement: Given an input-head movement $m\in\{-1,0,1\}$ and a transition record with value-tape write instruction $v$, mark-tape write instruction $w$, shared work-head movement $h\in\{-1,0,1\}$, optional output symbol $o$, and optional successor state $q$, form the action of a two-work-tape Boolean Turing machine that moves its input head by $m$, applies $v$ to the first work tape and $w$ to the second, moves both work heads by $h$, emits $o$, and passes to $q$, halting if $q$ is absent.
hypotheses_covered: An input-head movement in the sign type
A transition record containing two optional nested Boolean write instructions, a shared work-head movement, an optional output Boolean, and an optional successor state
